name: io.github.CyberPunk11147/cyberwarex-token-verdict
title: Token verdict before a trade: allow, review or block (x402)
description: Can my agent sell this token? Buy+sell sim, owner powers, taxes: allow/review/block. x402, 0.01.

tools.name: token_verdict
tools.description: Pre-trade check for one ERC-20: simulates a buy and a sell on its pool, reads owner powers (mint, pause, blacklist, trading switches) and the deployer's past launches, and answers decision allow, review or block with grade A-F, is_honeypot, tradeable, buy and sell tax and a one-line reason. $0.01 USDC per call via x402 (0.005 on a prepaid verdict pack key); a check that ends without a grade is not charged.

tokenAddress.description: ERC-20 token contract address, 0x + 40 hex chars

x_payment.description: x402 payment: base64 PaymentPayload for the invoice returned by an unpaid call (same value as the X-PAYMENT / PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header).

tools.name: honeypot_check
tools.description: Simulates a buy and a sell of the token and says whether a holder can sell it, with the measured round-trip loss. $0.005 USDC per call via x402.

address.description: ERC-20 token contract address, 0x + 40 hex chars

x_payment.description: x402 payment: base64 PaymentPayload for the invoice returned by an unpaid call (same value as the X-PAYMENT / PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header).

tools.name: token_safety
tools.description: The full evidence report for a token: grade A-F, sell simulation, owner and contract powers, holder concentration, liquidity and deployer history, each finding with its evidence. $0.01 USDC per call via x402.
